class.name: FoxPhysicsDragProfile
class.brief_description: A configuration profile defining the physics characteristics of a grab action.

members.member: The "strength" of the pull. High values make it snappy, low values make it feel heavy.
The "control" of the pull. High values slow it down, low values make it bouncy.
If [code]true[/code], forces the object to try and maintain an upright orientation.
